dedupe_keys.name: a large scale graph augmented traffic dataset for data driven spatio temporal traffic analysis

description: A large-scale graph-augmented traffic dataset for data-driven spatio-temporal traffic analysis is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by David Maria-Arribas et al. This paper introduces a large-scale, high-resolution traffic dataset collected from over 5,000 sensors across the city of Madrid, Spain, spanning a ten-year period, from 2015 to 2024. Comprising more than 1.5 billion records, the dataset includes key traffic metrics such as intensity, occupancy, and average speed, aggregated at 15-minute intervals. Coverage: national (ES); published in 2026. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The paper's page was read, but no repository address could be taken from its machine-readable metadata, so the record links to the article, whose Data Records section names where the data sit. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
